description.value: The Irving K. Barber Learning Centre is a landmark four-storey building on UBC's Vancouver campus, publicly accessible to all British Columbians as a hub for research, lifelong learning, and community engagement. It houses multiple library services including the Music, Art & Architecture Library and Chapman Learning Commons, alongside rotating art exhibits, event spaces, and community programs. Named after BC philanthropist Irving K. Barber, it is a notable cultural and educational destination for anyone exploring UBC's campus by bike.
